Within two hops, **OrderService needs 8 entities: 3 services, 2 APIs, and 3 databases.**

| Hop | Entity | Type | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PaymentsAPI | API | OrderService calls PaymentsAPI |
| 1 | PaymentsService | Service | Serves PaymentsAPI, which OrderService calls |
| 1 | UserService | Service | OrderService depends on UserService |
| 1 | OrdersPostgresDatabase | Database | OrderService stores data in OrdersPostgresDatabase |
| 2 | NotificationsAPI | API | PaymentsService calls NotificationsAPI |
| 2 | NotificationsService | Service | Serves NotificationsAPI, which PaymentsService calls |
| 2 | PaymentsPostgresDatabase | Database | PaymentsService stores data in PaymentsPostgresDatabase |
| 2 | UsersPostgresDatabase | Database | UserService stores data in UsersPostgresDatabase |

The API and the service serving it are counted at the same hop, as requested. No configuration keys were returned by this dependency traversal.
